prompt_md: 5 machines make 5 widgets in 5 minutes. How many minutes would 100 machines take to make 100 widgets?
hint_md: How long does one machine take to make one widget?
explain_intuition_md: Each machine makes one widget every 5 minutes. A hundred machines working at once make a hundred widgets in the same 5 minutes.
explain_math_md: Rate per machine $= \frac{1 \text{ widget}}{5 \text{ min}}$, so $100$ machines make $100$ widgets in $5$ minutes.
